title: Coil Allowance for Oversize Openings in Trim Capping — Installation Jobs
content:
**Coil allowance for oversize openings — trim capping on Installation Jobs**

Oversize openings take more coil and add to the priced openings when exterior trim capping is priced on an **Installation Jobs** record. The oversize openings are those recorded above the series' standard size at the latest completed measure of the **Window Replacement Contracts** contract the job installs — the most recent measure visit of that contract with a completed outcome.

| Oversize openings recorded at that measure | Each oversize opening counts as |
|---|---|
| 4 or more | two priced openings (2) |
| 1 to 3 | one and a half priced openings (1.5) |
| none | — every opening counts as one priced opening |

Every other opening on the contract counts as one priced opening. A door job, which installs no window contract, has no oversize opening.

## Worked examples (hypothetical inputs)

| Openings on the contract | Oversize openings at the latest completed measure | Priced openings |
|---|---|---|
| 10 | 0 | 10 |
| 10 | 2 | 8 counted once plus 2 counted as 1.5 each, that is 11 |
| 10 | 3 | 7 plus 4.5, that is 11.5 |
| 10 | 5 | 5 plus 10, that is 15 |

An earlier measure visit, or a measure visit that was not completed, does not decide the count; the latest completed one does.
